question: How does daily abstention from food affect death caused by aging?
premises: There is daily abstention from food
There is death caused by aging
The practitioner will go beyond that death
inference: Through daily abstention from food, one will overcome death caused by aging
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ is contextually interpreted as overcoming or transcending
plain_english: By abstaining from food day by day, one will overcome death caused by aging.
